feed.title: The Defias Brotherhood
feed.subtitle: Stormwind's stonemasons rebuilt the city and were never paid. Driven out, they became the Defias Brotherhood under Edwin VanCleef, and now they collect what the Crown owes them.

entry.title: Episode 0: Cargo
entry.summary: A Crown ship full of gold meets the Juggernaut in the fog. By dawn the gold is in the Deadmines, and Sneekis has brought VanCleef something he never ordered.
